interface.signature: def search(txt: str, pat: str) -> List[int]

preconditions.description: The length of the text string txt is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the pattern string pat is between 1 and one less than the length of txt.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(index, int) for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the returned list are integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(txt) for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All indices in the returned list are within the valid range of the text string txt.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [i + 1 for i in range(len(txt)) if txt[i:i+len(pat)] == pat]
postconditions.description: The returned list contains the starting indices (1-based) of all occurrences of the pattern string pat in the text string txt.
